neighbours.label: the pieces of a word that the tokenizer splits at 'var'/'vari' (var|iances, Vari|ance, vari|ational, vari|ate, in|var|iance, k_var in code); whole-token vari- words (variance, variable, various, variety) do not fire
fire: Each covariate was standardised before the variances were pooled across sites.
The random variate is drawn once per iteration and reused in both estimators.
Lorentz invariance requires the equations to look the same in every inertial frame.
A variational autoencoder learns a distribution over the latent code rather than a point.
The Variance class exposes a running estimate that updates with each new sample.
Unequal variances between the groups violate the assumption behind the t-test.
quiet: Each sample was standardised before the variance was pooled across sites.
The random variable is drawn once per iteration and reused in both estimators.
The equations are invariant under rotation in every inertial frame.
A variety of autoencoders learn a code rather than a distribution.
The Variation class exposes a running estimate that updates with each new sample.
Various differences between the groups violate the assumption behind the t-test.

predictions: Fire items 0.3-0.7 on the var piece or the piece after it; single-token twins under 0.2 (variance alone scored 0.195 in the probe, so one near miss may sit near the line).
